messages.text: I have a 40t on order. My guestion is for the KDBOX. Giving me an issue sewtting up

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed your KDBOX question over to me.

To point you the right way in one step: what exactly happens when you try to set it up?

1. Does it power on (fans spin, lights on)?
2. Can you find it on your network, or is that where it stops (no IP, doesn't show in the Goldshell/ApolloBTC-style finder tool or your router's client list)?

If it does get an IP and you reach the web UI, tell me what the screen or UI shows instead, including any error text, and I'll take it from there.

The miner is 10.0.0.70 in case you want  to look. The overheat warning is on from the timed I turned it on.  I ran it through an On & OFF session. Nothing works & I have no way to fix the overheat signal.? Look forward to your help. Im in Pa

That IP is on your home network, so I can't reach it from here, but you can read me what it shows.

An overheat flag the instant it powers on, before the chips have had time to actually heat up, is usually one of two things: the fan isn't spinning (or isn't reporting RPM), or a temperature sensor is reading bad data.

One check first: open 10.0.0.70 in your browser and tell me the two numbers on the status/overview page:

1. The temperature(s) it reports
2. The fan speed in RPM

And tell me if you can hear or feel the fan actually spinning when it's plugged in. If the temp reads something impossible like 0, 125 or a blank, that points at the sensor rather than real heat.
